# A gtk4 program in C runs its tests in the C test agent (pkg/c/runtime):
# each test builds the program, and a click is GTK's "clicked", which reaches
# the closure GLib holds through its dispatcher, the closure's state the box
# NoRef made of the component's var.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A slot renders into a box no class declared the append and remove of:
# the card's `if` takes its body out of the card's box and puts it back
# before its anchor, and a window under `if` is rendered into the
# application, SNGL_APP, which the runtime's box calls attach to and detach
# from it.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c slots.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A timer is a GLib timeout armed with the closure its effect mounts, whose
# body is the program's @tick handler: NoLambda leaves a lambda that emits
# to the inliner that answers the emit. A test's wait runs GTK's loop, and
# each test tears down the one before, so its timer ticks no later test's
# state.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c timer.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A canvas's click is a GtkGestureClick's press, which a test makes through
# the handler rt keeps on the drawing area (testdata/gtk4_c_canvas.txtar).

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c canvas.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A test's value is written into the widget as a user's edit would: a flip's
# state set, which fires the signal, and an entry's text put there with its
# "changed" blocked before the test fires it. A switch reports through
# notify::active, which connects like any signal.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c controls.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A scroll's end arriving is no signal: rt's scroll.c reads it off the
# adjustments, and a test fires the handler rt keeps. Its direction is the
# member's name, which NoEnum writes in place of the ordinal a string of an
# enum would otherwise format as.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c scroll.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A window's @key hears a key a test presses through rt's toplevel, as the
# program's handler takes it: the name a string, and rt's stop a closure the
# handler calls. The test's stop writes a local of the test's, which the
# lambda C lifts reaches through its address. int(s) and float(s) read the
# whole of s, and are 0 where it is no number.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c keys.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A unit of several bases is a struct of a double per base, which C adds,
# scales and compares through functions the file defines: a style built as
# the program runs holds them, and gtk4's look reads their fields. The
# numeric builtins are math.h's and the list's, a color's text is the
# runtime's, a string split by "" is its characters, a root's function a
# test calls is handed no component, and an assert in a loop is the test's.
# A struct copied out of a list copies its list after the list's copy is
# defined, and an option a root's var starts null is the option's zero.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c units.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A program whose output block names no C target is tested in C all the
# same: the test configures gtk4 for the language it runs in, which is what
# declares the widgets a C program calls.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c bare.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A row a slot population copies keeps its methods, which name the copy as
# their receiver; a checkbox's and an input's change handlers are boxed as
# two types; a spread the build cannot read is merged by a helper the file
# defines; and a scroll a slot holds is the widget its create made.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c rows.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A window's menu is rt's: each entry a hidden box among the window's
# content, from which menu.c builds the header bar's GMenu, and a test picks
# one copy of an entry a loop renders by its key (sngl_copy_put). A window's
# way back is a hidden widget the bar's back button presses, as an Escape
# nothing took does.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c menus.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A tabs is rt's box of a GtkNotebook (tabs.c), whose page a test chooses as
# a click does. A test's day is written into the calendar unreported, and
# its choice selected on the drop-down, which reports it; a date is its text.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c choose.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

# A flow is one label whose spans' words are its Pango markup, set again
# from the same expression wherever a span's prop is written. A payload enum
# is a tag and a field per member carrying one, and one a call the build
# folds returns is the literal naming its member. A widget a branch took away
# reads null, through the weak pointer rt holds it by.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c flow.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A callback's strings are made in the arena, which it gives back as it
# returns, so what a handler stores is kept: copied out to the heap, a list's
# elements, a map's keys and values and a struct's fields with it, and what
# the holder held before given back as the turn ends.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c keep.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A critical GLib logs fails the test running: a widget misused is a bug GTK
# survives and a test reading state would miss. A component built at run
# time attaches an instance by its root, renders a slot at its top into a
# box it makes first, and holds its slot's anchor itself.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c records.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

# A slot in a container of one child renders into a box that is the child; a
# tab a slot took away is gone from the notebook before the slot reads it
# again; and what a render no longer builds reads null though GTK still holds
# it: a widget by its weak pointer, a copy by the table of them, which a
# record's destroy and a widget finalized each leave too.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c holders.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #count(text="{n}", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testClickReachesTheClosure(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.count.click()
    c.count.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 2)
}
-- slots.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component card(name = "") ui.node {
    var open = true
    ui.button #toggle(text=name, @click {
        open = !open
    })
    if open {
        ui.text(value="body of " + name)
    }
}

var details = false

ui.window(title="t") {
    card(name="a")
}

if details {
    ui.window(title="details") {
        ui.text(value="more")
    }
}

func testToggleRemovesAndRestoresTheBody(t test.Test, c card) {
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(!c.open)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.open)
}
-- timer.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var (
        beats = 0
        running = true
    )
    time.timer(interval=100ms, enabled=running, @tick {
        beats += 1
    })
    ui.text(value="{beats}")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testTheTimerRunsTheHandler(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.beats >= 2, 2000)
    t.assert(c.beats >= 2)
}

func testTheGateStopsTheTimer(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.running = false
    t.wait(func() => c.beats > 0, 300)
    t.assert(c.beats == 0)
}
-- canvas.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component dot(r float) ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas(width=40px, height=40px) {
            draw.circle(cx=20.0, cy=20.0, r=r + float(n))
        }
        ui.button(text="grow", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var hits = 0
    var rs = [4.0, 8.0]
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas #board(width=40px, height=40px, scalingMode=draw.ScalingMode.fit, @click {
            hits += 1
        }) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=float(hits), h=10.0, style=draw.Style{lineCap=draw.LineCap.round})
        }
        for var r = rs {
            dot(r=r)
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testClickRedraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.board.click()
    c.board.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
}
-- controls.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var on = false
    var dark = false
    var name = "a"
    var changes = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.checkbox #box(label="x", checked=on, @change(v) {
            on = v
            changes += 1
        })
        ui.toggle #flip(checked=dark, @change(v) {
            dark = v
        })
        ui.input #field(value=name, @input(v) {
            name = v
        })
        ui.text(value="{name} {on}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testValuesReachTheHandlers(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.box.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on)
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.flip.change(true)
    t.assert(c.dark)
    c.field.input("bee")
    t.assert(c.name == "bee")
}
-- keys.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component app root {
    var typed = ""
    var total = 0.0
    var count = 0
    ui.window #win(title="t", @key(e, stop) {
        if e.ctrl {
            return
        }
        typed = typed + e.key
        total += float(e.key)
        count += int(e.key)
        if e.key == "x" {
            stop()
        }
    }) {
        ui.text(value=typed)
    }
}

app()

func testKeysReachTheWindow(t test.Test, c app) {
    var stopped = 0
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="7"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="x"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="s", ctrl=true}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="2.5"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    t.assert(c.typed == "7x2.5")
    t.assert(stopped == 1)
    t.assert(c.total == 9.5)
    t.assert(c.count == 7)
}

-- units.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

struct key {
    label string
    tags  list[string] = []
}

component app root {
    var span = 1
    var pad ui.measurement = 4px
    var shade color = #15171c
    var picked option[key] = null

    func grow() {
        span += 1
        pad = pad * 2 + 1em
        var keys = [key{label="a", tags=["x", "y"]}]
        picked = keys[0]
    }

    ui.window(title="t") {
        ui.text(value="x", style={flex=span, padding=pad, margin=pad - 2px, background=shade})
    }
}

app()

func testUnitsAndNumbers(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.grow()
    t.assert(c.span == 2)
    t.assert(c.picked != null && c.picked.tags.length() == 2)
    t.assert(c.pad == 8px + 1em)
    t.assert(c.pad.px == 8.0 && c.pad.em == 1.0)
    t.assert(string(c.shade) == "#15171c")
    t.assert(float.max(1.5, 2.5, 0.5) == 2.5 && int.min(3, 1, 2) == 1)
    t.assert(float.round(2.5) == 3.0 && float.abs(-2.0) == 2.0 && int.clamp(9, 0, 5) == 5)
    for var ch = string.split("héllo", "") {
        t.assert(string.length(ch) == 1)
    }
}
-- rows.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component tag(label string, style ui.Style = ui.Style{}) ui.node {
    ui.text(value=label, style={...style, padding=4px})
}

component row(label string, foot component(v int) ui.node) ui.node {
    var marks = 0

    func mark(n int) {
        marks = marks + n
    }

    func summary() string {
        return "{label}={marks}"
    }

    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value=summary())
        foot(marks)
        ui.effect(@mount { mark(2) })
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var log = ""
    var shown = true
    var look = ui.Style{}
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #hide(text="hide", @click { shown = false })
        for var it = items {
            row(label=it) {
                component foot(v) {
                    ui.text(value="foot {it} {v}")
                }
            }
            ui.checkbox(label=it, @change(on) { log = "{it} {on}" })
            ui.input(value=it, @change(v) { log = "{it}={v}" })
            tag(label=it, style=look)
        }
        if shown {
            ui.scroll {
                ui.text(value="maybe")
            }
        }
        ui.text(value=log)
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testRows(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.log == "")
    c.hide.click()
    t.assert(!c.shown)
}
-- scroll.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import c "sngl:language/c"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        gtk4(gir="builtin")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var rows = [1, 2, 3]
    var asked = 0
    var way = ui.ScrollDirection.vertical
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #label(value="{way}")
        ui.scroll #list(direction=way, @reachEnd {
            asked += 1
            rows.push(asked + 3)
        }) {
            ui.vbox {
                for var r = rows {
                    ui.text(value="row {r}")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testTheEndAsksForMore(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.list.reachEnd()
    t.assert(c.asked == 1)
}

func testADirectionIsItsName(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(string(c.way) == "vertical")
    c.way = ui.ScrollDirection.both
    t.assert(string(c.way) == "both")
    t.assert("{c.way}" == "both")
}
-- menus.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

const sizes = ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]

component app root {
    var size = "Medium"
    var saved = 0
    var backs = 0

    ui.window #main(title=pages.current.title, canGoBack=pages.canGoBack(), @back {
        backs += 1
        pages.back()
    }) {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="File") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Save", @select { saved += 1 })
                ui.menuItem(label="Close", disabled=true)
            }
            ui.menuItem(label="Size") {
                for var s = sizes {
                    ui.menuItem(label=s, checked=s == size, @select { size = s })
                }
            }
        }
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
                ui.text(value="home")
            }
            nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About") {
                ui.text(value="about")
            }
        }
        ui.button #toAbout(text="About", @click { pages.go(about) })
        ui.text #shown(value=size)
    }
}

app()

func testPickingAnEntryChecksIt(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.main.menu[1].children[1].checked)
    c.main.menu[1].children[2].select()
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "Large")
    c.main.menu[0].children[0].select()
    t.assert(c.saved == 1)
}

func testTheWindowsBackReturns(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(!c.main.canGoBack)
    c.toAbout.click()
    t.assert(c.main.canGoBack)
    c.main.back()
    t.assert(c.backs == 1)
    t.assert(c.main.title == "Home")
}
-- choose.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"

component strip ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var changed = -1
    var extra = false
    var picked option[time.date] = null
    var seen = "none"
    var fruit = "Apple"

    ui.vbox {
        ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=idx, @change(i) {
            changed = i
        }) {
            ui.tab(label="One") {
                ui.text(value="first panel")
            }
            ui.tab(label="Off", disabled=true) {
                ui.text(value="second panel")
            }
            if extra {
                ui.tab(label="More") {
                    ui.text(value="more panel")
                }
            }
        }
        ui.datepicker #day(:value=picked, @change(value) { seen = value == null ? "no day" : "day" })
        ui.select #fruits(:value=fruit) {
            ui.choice(label="Apple", value="Apple")
            ui.choice(label="Banana", value="Banana")
        }
    }
}

func testPressingATabSelectsIt(t test.Test, c strip) {
    c.extra = true
    c.tabs.change(2)
    t.assert(c.idx == 2)
    t.assert(c.changed == 2)
}

func testADayIsChosen(t test.Test, c strip) {
    var d time.date = "2024-03-05"
    c.day.change(d)
    t.assert(c.picked == d)
    t.assert(c.seen == "day")
}

func testAChoiceIsPicked(t test.Test, c strip) {
    c.fruits.change("Banana")
    t.assert(c.fruit == "Banana")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    strip
}
-- flow.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

enum Shape {
    round  float
    square float
    empty
}

func area(s Shape) float {
    match var v = s {
        round {
            return 3.0 * v * v
        }
        square {
            return v * v
        }
        empty {
            return 0.0
        }
    }
}

// A call the build folds is written back as the literal naming its member.
func first(side float) Shape {
    if side > 2.0 {
        return {square=side}
    }
    return Shape.empty
}

component main node {
    var loud = true
    var shape Shape = {round=1.0}
    var picked = first(3.0)
    var shown = true

    vbox {
        md.paragraph {
            md.text(value="quiet ")
            if loud {
                md.bold {
                    md.text(value="LOUD")
                }
            } else {
                md.italic {
                    md.text(value="soft")
                }
            }
            md.text(value=" end")
        }
        button #flip(text="flip", @click {
            loud = !loud
            shape = {square=2.0}
            picked = Shape.empty
        })
        button #toggle(text="t", @click { shown = !shown })
        text(value="{area(shape)}")
        if shown {
            text #label(value="shown")
        }
    }
}

func testFlip(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(!c.loud)
    t.assert(c.shape == Shape{square=2.0})
    t.assert(area(c.shape) == 4.0)
    t.assert(c.picked == Shape.empty)
}

func testNullTestsFollowTheBranch(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.picked == Shape{square=3.0})
    t.assert(c.label != null)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.label == null)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.label != null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- keep.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

struct Entry {
    name string
    tags list[string]
}

component ticker ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var last = "none"
    var seen list[string] = []
    var names map[string, string] = {}
    var entry = Entry{name="", tags=[]}

    ui.button #tick(text="tick", @click {
        n += 1
        last = "tick {n}"
        seen.push("t{n}")
        names["k{n}"] = "v{n}"
        entry = {name="e{n}", tags=["a{n}", "b{n}"]}
    })
    ui.text(value=last)
}

func testWhatAHandlerStoresOutlivesIt(t test.Test, c ticker) {
    c.tick.click()
    c.tick.click()
    t.assert(c.last == "tick 2")
    t.assert(c.seen.format(",") == "t1,t2")
    t.assert(c.names["k1"] == "v1" && c.names["k2"] == "v2")
    t.assert(c.entry.name == "e2" && c.entry.tags.format(",") == "a2,b2")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    ticker
}
-- records.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

// An instance a record's body makes is attached to the box around it by
// its root, and a record whose body is a slot renders it into a box it
// makes first, after the widgets written ahead of it.
component counter(tag string, @seen(v string)) ui.node {
    var n = 0

    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="counter {tag} {n}")
        ui.effect(on="{tag}:{n}", @mount(k) { seen(k) })
    }
}

component card(start int, foot component(v int) ui.node) ui.node {
    var k = start * 2

    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="card {k}")
        foot(k)
    }
}

component population ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2]
    var foots = ""

    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            card(start=i) {
                component foot(v) {
                    counter(tag="{i}/{v}", @seen(s) { foots = foots + s + " " })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testInstancesMount(t test.Test, c population) {
    t.assert(c.foots == "1/2:0 2/4:0 ")
}

component badge(label string) ui.node {
    var hits = 0

    ui.button #hit(text="hit {label} {hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component rows ui.node {
    var lines = [["a", "b"], ["a", "b"]]
    var skip = "b"

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #move(text="m", @click { skip = "a" })
        for var r = lines {
            ui.vbox {
                var local = 0

                ui.text(value="{local}")
                for var n = r {
                    if n != skip {
                        badge #b(label=n)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testACopyPerRow(t test.Test, c rows) {
    t.assert(c.b[0][0] != null)
    t.assert(c.b[0][1] == null)
    c.move.click()
    t.assert(c.b[0][0] == null)
    t.assert(c.b[0][1] != null)
    t.assert(c.b[1][1] != null)
}

// Each instance renders its slot before an anchor of its own: one an
// instance destroyed held is no other's.
component sign(:msg string = "inner") ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(msg)
        ui.button(text="again", @click { msg = "again" })
    }
}

component asked ui.node {
    var shown = true

    if shown {
        sign #failed()
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var on = true
    var outer = "outer"

    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #failed(outer)
        if on {
            asked()
        }
    }
}

func testAnInstanceBuiltAgain(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.failed.value == "outer")
    c.on = false
    c.on = true
    t.assert(c.failed.value == "outer")
}

ui.window {
    population
    rows
    page
}
-- holders.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

// A slot inside a container holding one child -- a card's frame, a
// scroll -- renders into a box that is that child.
component framed ui.node {
    var opened = ""

    ui.vbox {
        for var name = ["one", "two"] {
            ui.card #row(clickable=true, @click { opened = name }) {
                ui.text(value=name)
            }
        }
        ui.card(variant="outlined") {
            if opened != "" {
                ui.text(value="opened {opened}")
            }
        }
        ui.scroll {
            if opened != "" {
                ui.text(value="scrolled {opened}")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testClickOpens(t test.Test, c framed) {
    c.row[1].click()
    t.assert(c.opened == "two")
    c.row[0].click()
    t.assert(c.opened == "one")
}

// A tab a slot takes away is out of the notebook, and the slot's next
// render reads nothing of it.
component strip ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var changed = -1
    var extra = false

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=idx, @change(i) { changed = i }) {
        ui.tab(label="One") {
            ui.text(value="first panel")
        }
        if extra {
            ui.tab(label="More") {
                ui.text(value="more panel")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testATabComesAndGoes(t test.Test, c strip) {
    c.extra = true
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.changed == 1)
    c.idx = 0
    c.extra = false
    t.assert(c.changed == 1)
}

// A test reads one copy of a node loops render by its key, null where the
// render took it away, whether the file or an instance holds it.
component picks ui.node {
    var items = ["a", "b", "c"]
    var skip = "a"

    ui.button #change(text="skip b", @click { skip = "b" })
    for var it = items {
        if it != skip {
            ui.button #only(text=it)
            ui.text #note(value=it)
            ui.checkbox #tick(label=it, @change(on) {})
        }
    }
}

func testTheCopiesABranchRenders(t test.Test, c picks) {
    t.assert(c.only[0] == null)
    t.assert(c.tick[1] != null)
    c.change.click()
    t.assert(c.only[0] != null)
    t.assert(c.only[1] == null)
    t.assert(c.note[1] == null)
    t.assert(c.tick[1] == null)
}

// A widget a branch the render no longer takes built reads null, whether or
// not GTK has let it go yet.
enum Dir { up, down }

component dial ui.node {
    var d Dir = up

    match d {
        up { ui.text #north(value="north") }
        else { ui.text(value="south") }
    }
    ui.button #spin(text="Spin", @click {
        d = d == Dir.up ? Dir.down : Dir.up
    })
}

func testTheBranchTaken(t test.Test, c dial) {
    t.assert(c.north != null)
    c.spin.click()
    t.assert(c.north == null)
    c.spin.click()
    t.assert(c.north != null)
}

ui.window {
    dial
    framed
    strip
    picks
}
